about: Frozen dock-dense plant 44 (golden fixture layout), 30 min: zero-length legs, relocated legs, a window shorter than 20 minutes.

insights.title: Traffic is costing time: vehicles spend 36 % of their driving time waiting.
insights.detail: Together, vehicles waited 34.5 min in the last 30 min: 42 % behind other vehicles, 58 % for junctions and 0 % behind broken-down vehicles. The worst spots are (5, 2) with 10.4 min, (9, 2) with 6.4 min, (4, 2) with 5.4 min.
insights.suggestion: Most waiting happens at junctions around (5, 2), (9, 2), (4, 2): give the main route its own road, or make one of the crossing roads one-way.

insights.title: Custom vehicle fleet is saturated: its 6 vehicles are busy 85 % of the time, and loads wait 2.8 min for a pickup.
insights.detail: Over 30 min, a Custom vehicle vehicle spent 33 % of its time driving, 19 % waiting in traffic and 32 % loading or unloading, and made 33 trips per hour. Loads waited 2.8 min for pickup on average.
insights.suggestion: A lot of the busy time is spent waiting in traffic (19 % of the fleet's time): relieve the congestion around (5, 2) before buying more vehicles.

insights.title: Vehicles blocked each other in a deadlock 3 times.
insights.detail: Vehicles waited on each other in a circle around (4, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1). The simulation moved one vehicle out of the way each time; in a real plant someone would have to intervene.
insights.suggestion: Break the circle around (4, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1): make the narrow aisle one-way, add a passing bay, or reduce the number of vehicles that use it at the same time.

insights.title: B waits for input 73 % of the time.
insights.detail: Over 30 min, B was idle for lack of input loads 73 % of the time and worked 27 %.
insights.suggestion: On average 12 loads wait at E for a vehicle, but congestion holds the vehicles up around (5, 2), (9, 2), (4, 2): relieve the traffic before adding vehicles.

insights.title: E delivers more than the plant takes: 8 loads are piling up in its yard.
insights.detail: Over 30 min, the output buffer of E was full 29 % of the time. The backlog in front of it peaked at 9 loads and stands at 8 now.
insights.suggestion: On average 12 loads wait at E for a vehicle, but congestion holds the vehicles up around (5, 2), (9, 2), (4, 2): relieve the traffic before adding vehicles.
